newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to hold above crucial 101.46.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to hold above crucial 101.46.

text.p: LIFFE September Bund futures are in a consolidative phase, and while key support at 101.46 holds the uptrend is likely to resume on Thursday, technical analysts said.
Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase in London, said initial support was at Wednesday's low of 101.54.

"The market is trying to put a corrective bottom in place and holding these support levels is going to be important. But if it breaks 101.46 then that's going to leave the market vulnerable in the near-term," he said.
By 0700 GMT, September Bunds were 0.10 lower at 101.61.
Stannard said if Monday's high of 101.46 held, then a recovery back towards the high of the current range at 101.76, followed by a challenge of the June peak of 101.88 could be expected.
"It started lower this morning so holding support levels will be very important," he said.
If 101.46 broke, Bunds would be prone to losses towards the 100.94 low of June 20, he said.
Analysts said the market was under pressure in the near-term but the recovery that started last Friday looked convincing, and further gains were on the cards with Bunds forming a base here.
Richard Adcock, technical research manager at HSBC Futures in London, said 101.88 should be breached to signal a sustainable move through the contract highs.
"We feel the stochastic background suggests the move will be seen in due course," Adcock said in a research note.
A pullback to 101.46 could develop, but such action should be considered as a buying opportunity, he said.
He pegged resistance at 101.70, 101.99, 102.12 and most importantly at 102.25.
September Euromark futures were at 96.84, up 0.01 on the day.
